name: unsafe fn get_mut_unchecked (this : & mut Self) -> & mut T
rule: If any other Rc or Weak pointers to the same allocation as this Rc exist, they must not have active borrows for the duration of the mutable borrow returned by get_mut_unchecked.
api: impl < T : ? Sized , A : Allocator > alloc::rc::Rc < T , A > { unsafe fn get_mut_unchecked (this : & mut Self) -> & mut T }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it cannot quantify over other Rc or Weak pointers or represent their active borrows throughout the returned mutable borrow’s lifetime.
